description: Calculate Vedic divisional charts (Vargas). Each division reveals a specific life area: D2 Hora (wealth), D3 Drekkana (siblings), D4 Chaturthamsa (property), D7 Saptamsa (children), D9 Navamsa (marriage/dharma — most important after Rashi), D10 Dashamsa (career), D12 Dwadashamsa (parents), D16 Shodasamsa (vehicles), D20 Vimsamsa (spiritual), D24 Chaturvimsamsa (education), D27 Bhamsa (strength), D30 Trimsamsa (evils), D40 Khavedamsa (maternal), D45 Akshavedamsa (paternal), D60 Shashtiamsa (past-life karma). Vedika Ephemeris computed. Cost: $0.005/call.

ayanamsa.description: Sidereal zodiac correction. Default: lahiri. Only for Vedic calculations.

chart.description: Divisional chart. D9 (Navamsa) is the most important after the birth chart.

datetime.description: Birth date and time in ISO 8601 format, e.g. "1990-06-15T14:30:00". Required for all chart calculations.

latitude.description: Birth location latitude (-90 to 90). Polar latitudes >66.5 are rejected (house calculations unreliable).

timezone.description: Timezone as UTC offset "+05:30" or IANA "Asia/Kolkata". UTC offsets preferred.

name: vedika_divisional_charts
